desc: a Japanese miso soup in a red-brown lacquered wooden bowl, cloudy light-brown miso broth with small white tofu cubes and dark green wakame seaweed pieces, a few thin green onion rings floating

natto fermented soybeans in a small bowl, glossy small brown beans stringy and sticky with fine white threads, a dab of yellow mustard
a mound of freshly cooked plain white Japanese short-grain rice in a ceramic rice bowl (chawan), glossy plump grains sticking together slightly
a Japanese shokupan white bread loaf with two thick square slices cut off, soft fine white crumb and a thin golden-brown crust
a bunch of three ripe yellow bananas with green-brown tips and a few small brown freckles
a whole red apple with a short stem and a wedge cut from it, glossy red skin and crisp pale cream flesh
two Japanese mikan mandarin oranges, small round bright orange fruits with dimpled peel, one half peeled showing juicy segments
a whole round green cabbage with a quarter cut away showing tightly packed pale green and white layered leaves inside

a whole brown onion with dry golden-brown papery skin and a half onion cut across showing white concentric rings
